How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Project Associate-I Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 03-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT (ISM) Dhanbad to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Project Associate-I position at IIT (ISM) Dhanbad?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Project Associate-I post is 03 September 2026. Ensure you submit your application well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate-I role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech/M.S./MCA/M.Sc degree in CSE, Mathematics & Computing, ECE, EE, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or related disciplines.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Associate-I position is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-I position?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 25,000 to Rs. 31,000 per month. The exact amount depends on whether the candidate has qualified for GATE or NET.

faq.question: Q5. How will the candidates be selected for the Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: The selection process will primarily involve an interview, which may be conducted via video conferencing.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies for the Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Associate-I position at IIT (ISM) Dhanbad.

faq.question: Q8. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The job is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT (ISM) Dhanbad located?
faq.answer: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad is located in Dhanbad, Jharkhand.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply offline for this position?
faq.answer: No, applications must be submitted online only through the official website or the provided application link.
